caption: The drawing depicts two pieces of clothing rendered in blue and white on a light beige background. The primary and largest garment, positioned in the upper right, is a long-sleeved dress with a fitted bodice. The bodice and sleeves are textured with a lattice-like pattern and dotted with blue, while the skirt is vertically striped and adorned with horizontal blue trimming at the lower part and hem. Nearby, in the lower left, there is a matching bonnet or cap, also textured in a lattice pattern, which features two long ribbons or ties hanging down and a blue band near its bottom edge. The artist’s signature, “Rosy Päßler,” appears in small letters to the lower right of the dress.
title: Child's Dress
